bead.title: K1 — Characterize Pi/Claude render contracts and Codex surface boundary
bead.description:
## PROBLEM
The Specialists interactive surface is modeled for Pi and Claude, while openai-codex provider execution can be confused with a native Codex harness.

## SUCCESS
Capture Pi/Claude rendering, role, model, help, view, byte-ceiling, and launcher behavior; define the distinct Codex surface boundary and the K2 outcome fields Specialists consumes.

## SCOPE
Read-only characterization and fixtures in Specialists. Identify exact surface/model/role extension seams.

## NON_GOALS
Do not implement the Codex surface, direct codex exec, Core launcher behavior, or xtmux lifecycle.

## CONSTRAINTS
Interactive surface identity must remain distinct from provider IDs. Preserve Pi/Claude outputs as compatibility baselines. Treat Core K2 as an external contract.

## VALIDATION
Run current render/view/help tests and record golden fixtures. Prove openai-codex/... remains a provider/model spelling rather than a Codex surface alias.

## OUTPUT
A Specialists characterization packet that blocks K3-Specialists.
